Package org.Jtech.Controller

Class ProductInsightController

java.lang.Object
org.Jtech.Controller.ProductInsightController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/v1/products") public class ProductInsightController extends Object
Product Insight Controller Purpose: Exposes REST APIs for analyzing products and generating insights based on ingredient and chemical information. Scope: - Analyze product ingredients and chemicals - Provide safety and composition insights during product scanning Metadata: Added on : 2026-02-06 Author : Mohit Singh Notes: These APIs are primarily used during product scanning and analysis flows in the application. AI-based processing is delegated to the service layer.

  • Method Details

    • extractProductDetails

      @PostMapping("extract-details") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> extractProductDetails(@RequestBody String productText)
      Extract structured product details from unstructured OCR text. Used for: - Processing raw OCR output from scanned product labels - Extracting product name, category, chemical list, expiry date, and price information
      Parameters:
      productText - unstructured OCR text obtained from product label scanning
      Returns:
      extracted structured product details

    • evaluateProductSuitability

      @PostMapping("/evaluation") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> evaluateProductSuitability(@RequestBody ProductEvaluationRequest request)
      Evaluate a product based on user profile and ingredient information. Used for: - Assessing product suitability for a user - Evaluating safety based on ingredients, allergies, and preferences
      Parameters:
      request - product and user evaluation request data
      Returns:
      product evaluation result

    • generateProductUsageGuide

      @PostMapping("/usage-guide") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> generateProductUsageGuide(@RequestBody ProductEvaluationRequest request)
      Generate usage guidance for a product based on evaluation data. Used for: - Providing usage instructions and recommendations - Guiding users on safe and effective product usage
      Parameters:
      request - product evaluation data used to generate usage guidance
      Returns:
      product usage guide and recommendations

    • getGoodChemicals

      @PostMapping("/chemicals/good") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> getGoodChemicals(@RequestBody GoodChemicalRequestDTO goodChemicalRequestDTO)
      Retrieve beneficial (good) chemicals for a product to show it as table in UI. Used for: - Identifying safe or beneficial chemicals present in a product - Displaying positive ingredient information to users
      Parameters:
      goodChemicalRequestDTO - request data containing product and evaluation context
      Returns:
      list of beneficial chemicals with usage information

      Retrieve harmful or unsafe chemicals for a product. Used for: - Identifying chemicals that may be unsafe or unsuitable for a user - Highlighting potentially harmful ingredients in a product
